ops.body:
- **T? [owner] An area card and "What I'm into" name the same categories in different words** (2026-11-19)
  Area: explore. Seen: `sg-card-kinds.png` (the `atlas` journey, `/tend presence`'s lenses): the card's bars read "Green" and "Views" while "What I'm into" heads the same categories "Parks & green spaces" and "Viewpoints & oddities" (`subtypes-what-im-into-parks.png`), and "How the marks work" sends the reader there in the card's words. Two tables name them: `ATLAS_LABEL` (`src/lib/atlas/atlas.ts`) and `CATEGORIES` (`src/lib/discovery/categories.ts`), which also gives the found line's and its announcement's words ("Food & drink"). The lenses' ux-reviewer 1 (medium) and steward 6. Rests on: `docs/research/ui-references.md` section 1.13, H4 ("the same action has the same word and icon on every screen").
  Recommended: the owner's shape: one table for the eight categories' names, read by the card, the tile's spoken name, the explanation and "What I'm into"'s headings, both reading "Green" and "Views & oddities", with a muted line under each heading of "What I'm into" ("Parks, gardens and nature"); the planner's and the kind walk's sentences take each category's noun, so none reads "views & oddities is concentrated". /vision: aligned (Earn: one name for a kind on every screen; words only, no count). Slice-sized, not one commit: it reaches eight source files (the two tables, `explore/intoPage.ts`, `components/IntoPage.tsx`, `kindWalk/words.ts`, `walkPlanner/words.ts`, `walkPlanner/service.ts`, `atlas/waitingPins.ts`) past the run's six, and the card's row at 320 px ("Views & oddities", its step word, its dots and "Suggest a walk") must be pictured first.
  Precedent: iOS Settings and Android's notification settings name a group with one heading, the same on the list and the page it opens (docs/research/adjacent-apps.md, "Choose what you are shown: a long list of switches", verified); Google Maps' Settings put a plain heading over each section (same job, unverified).
  Otherwise: the card's words alone, "What I'm into" as it is.

Nov 19: the owner's yes, in person, 2026-11-19: "Short card words (Recommended)": the card and "What I'm into" both read "Green" and "Views & oddities", and "What I'm into" keeps a muted line under each heading (for example "Parks, gardens and nature") (decision 0238). Held from `/tend presence` (over the run's size); waits for a build.

- [loop] `LANDING_CARRIED` (`src/lib/landing/view.ts` l.21) still holds the version from before presence, which no row of a current code can carry since `PRESENCE_CARRIED` is empty, and `presenceAudit.test.ts` ("presence audit 1: a landing row from before presence still lists and is not stale") pins it standing. Drop it and invert the test (the lenses' auditor 3, `/tend presence`, Nov 19; low)

- [loop] Overture's other names for SF10's kinds (public art, a viewpoint, a cemetery under another root) are not in the three Overture fixtures the repo holds, and the pinned release's taxonomy could not be read from the session (docs.overturemaps.org refused; no taxonomy file in OvertureMaps/schema at the paths tried): `tend presence 2` gave rows only to `historic_site`, `memorial_site`, `park` and `recreational_trail_or_path`. Read the release's taxonomy and give each such name an `OVERTURE_DEEPER` row, with a `PRESENCE_CODE` bump (`/tend presence`, Nov 19; low)

- [owner] A museum of a town's past lights History only when the archive records it or its name says historic; one named plainly for its town, which the data cannot tell, lights Culture alone (the lenses' steward, silent 3, `/tend presence`, Nov 19: "Should a museum of a town's past light History when neither the archive nor its name says so, which the data cannot tell?"; low)

- [owner] A nature reserve from the map is "Parks and gardens" (`reserve`, no subtype), the archive's the subtype "Nature reserves" (`nature_reserve`), so "Nature reserves" off hides only the archive's; a notable-named map reserve stays a "?" under Parks (`presence.ts`, `OSM.park` and `nature_reserve` against `ARCHIVE.nature_reserve`; MA3). The real samples hold no map reserve. A change is a reclassification: a `PRESENCE_CODE` bump, the golden's `CHANGED` and the spec's PR5 table (the lenses' auditor 4, `/tend presence`, Nov 19; low)

- [loop] Amusement parks sits under "Zoos and aquariums", so switching zoos off locks it off (`presence.ts` `amusement` of kind `attractions`; `explore.ts`, `subtypes.ts`); the owner asked for its "own row" (more-attractions audit 1). Its own kind row under "Views & oddities" is a reclassification: build it with the next `PRESENCE_CODE` bump (the lenses' ux-reviewer 3, `/tend presence`, Nov 19; low)

argv: The area card's kind rows draw three presence dots
ops.body: - [owner] The tile's strip draws its dots with no word ("●○○", `sg-tile-fox-320.png`) and the card draws "○○○" beside "none": the lenses' ux-reviewer reads both as a rating, reopening the item above ("VISION, Nothing is a score"); the lenses' steward does not reopen it: "0067 words on card; 0202 none on tile". Whether the tile's dots need a word is the owner's (`/tend presence`, Nov 19; low)

- [loop] "How the marks work" names "What I'm into" with no way to it and no word of where it is (`11c-atlas-card.png`; H6, H10): a link, or "in a walk's settings" (the lenses' ux-reviewer 4, `/tend presence`, Nov 19; low)

- [loop] The card's presence dots move from column to column row by row, set after words of different widths ("some", "none") (`sg-card-kinds.png`, `sf-card-storefronts.png`): a fixed column would let the eye run down them (the lenses' ux-reviewer 5, an opinion, `/tend presence`, Nov 19; low)

argv: Map, walk screen and motion polish
ops.body: - [loop] A "?" card's title wraps inside its kind: "Hessian Memorial · Monuments / and memorials" at 390 px (`02a-place-card.png`, `src/app/walk.tsx`, the mark card): the kind on a muted line of its own would keep both whole (the lenses' ux-reviewer 6, an opinion, `/tend presence`, Nov 19; low)

- **`.claude/rules/presence.md` l.17 still says `ATLAS_CODE` (`a14.p4`)** (Nov 19). What ships: `ATLAS_CODE` is `a15.p11` since `tend presence 2` (`atlas.ts`, `ATLAS_OWN` a15; `PRESENCE_CODE` p11). The line names a value that moves with every bump; naming `ATLAS_OWN` and `PRESENCE_CODE` instead would keep it true (`/tend presence`'s lenses, F3 and the auditor's 5; the comments in `atlas.ts` were put right in `tend presence 7`).
